sentence: Admission to the Online Undergraduate BSN Professional Program or permission by the instructor or department head, and students must have completed all University core and program prerequisites.

items.quote: Admission to the Online Undergraduate BSN Professional Program
permission by the instructor or department head
and students must have completed all University core and program prerequisites.

argument: The sentence contains a top-level 'and' connecting two main clauses: the first clause offers alternatives ('Admission...' or 'permission...'), and the second clause states a mandatory condition ('students must have completed...'). According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, the 'or' within the first clause creates an 'any_of' group where one path fulfills that part. The top-level 'and' implies that both the result of the 'any_of' group AND the second text condition are required, forming a root 'all_of' node per the definition of ceterms:requires.
